implementation_status.verified_mechanism: channels/0.1.json records the product-verified 12-repository + 7-corpus combination for release pipeline gating and audit provenance; clients do not download channels/0.1.json to select updates. Host plugins select compatible plugin Releases via harness-compatibility.json, and discover formal GitHub Releases across the 8 runtime/evaluation components directly from each official repository using monotonic max(installed, baseline, latest) selection without downgrades, dereferenced tag SHA + pyproject.toml + benchmark-results.json (release_gate) verification, side-by-side uv override runtime builds from exact Git SHAs, model-free API probes, and idle cutover while preserving native host payloads and without activating knowledge or capture (Codex/CC reuse a cancellable 300s check inside the MCP server process; Kimi runs a 300s launchd/schtasks job switching current.json; DSH runs a host-scoped idle timer mounting ./host3.mjs + remote-dev from the canonical adapter binding in config.json, with current.json only as a legacy seed fallback).

patch_releases.summary: Initial 0.1.0 milestone baseline and Release Channel Manifest contract (channels/0.1.json). All 4 host plugins (v0.1.0) verify locked plugin-release auto-updates; direct runtime consumption of channels/0.1.json for in-place 0.1.x single-component hotfixes is the 0.1.x target architecture.

0.1.1 maintenance patch: formal component releases for knowledge v0.13.3 (38a42f6f778cfa555d8918fdcacd12cee4a181f5; per-session manual /mindie-agent gate, whole-delivery token budget estimation, deduplicated delivery receipts, and direct GitHub Release component update discovery/runtime build), remote-dev v0.10.6 (0463a13fce9618ec9a51904869d61acb0cdb8538; primary SSH exception preservation with cleanup_error and dual-Die A3 / measured free HBM normalization), diagnostics v0.5.2 (801a01b2789aed7f58e971a909205a7d40b61077; cooperative JSONL record-boundary intake drain and offline stage-admission budget), sim v0.7.1 (15f93f3f0247b2653d0e9441eae56959e4d16d4e; profiled_kernel cost plans with captured median duration floors), coordinator v0.6.3 (0ec71fb947ab24df8e543dcf056f4f06664baad8; preparation job refresh, factual A5/A3 HBM telemetry, and host-capacity placement admission), and mindie-bench v0.4.4 (a36d8a5ae8633e560d19fee231179c3680149109; behavior-executed verifiers for 6 tasks, strategy-selection continuation isolation, release-kind=patch collector gate, and HTTP/1.1 chunked settlement close-race fix), reusing profiler v0.5.0 and npu-top v0.2.1; formal v0.1.2 releases across all four native host plugins (Codex 0b3c690b95401631782a656d99f2b4487582636a, CC edabca82e02fb313d734c699e75735095effebfd, Kimi 7aecfd22857c313b52d6fe5923292f297884fec0, DSH a38f1cb191f625905aace734e20a2ad196624b60) verified on macOS arm64 for exploration pass-through, session gating, and independent component updates (docs/releases/0.1.1/native-update-acceptance.json), plus the offline CPU engineering reproduction and G5 dev pilot report (docs/releases/0.1.1/benchmark-pilot.md).

Shared SSH authentication in remote-dev 0.11.1 provides one-time password enrollment, public-key installation and recovery, cross-process/chat/plugin reuse, read-only monitor password fallback, and Git for Windows 2.56 SSH discovery. coordinator 0.7.0 and npu-top 0.3.0 reuse the same store. Codex 0.1.12, Claude Code 0.1.8, Kimi 0.1.7 and DSH 0.1.6 expose remote_auth and pin formal remote-dev 0.11.1; diagnostics aligns to existing formal 0.5.4. Nineteen real SSH tests across macOS, native PowerShell and actual WSL2 pass. Formal assets and source-bound benchmarks are verified; plugin initial baselines, isolated previous-formal updater acceptance and native catalog reload boundaries are recorded separately. The remaining component and seven corpus pins are preserved; historical value results are not relabeled.

profiler 0.5.1 (25c789cd42389c893234c5db20eca67e63b8878a) adds streaming native-library SHA256 digest checks, >=3s SQLite busy_timeout alignment, explicit TimeoutError propagation, and root CLI help/unknown-command diagnostics. Knowledge 0.13.7 and four native plugin releases enable information-gap retrieval, shared explanation budgets, exact prerequisite revisions, and updates for managed Python module bindings. Historical simple-task cost signals and failed complex-task non-regression remain separately documented; automatic upgrades, one-time recovery of the damaged Kimi installation, and host reload evidence are recorded in docs/releases/0.1.4/automatic-update-acceptance.json.
